name: Netflix Clone
tagline: Responsive streaming application interface with dynamic TMDB media catalog integration.
description: Full-featured Netflix web interface replica focused on fluid media exploration, asynchronous API data consumption, responsive carousel carousels, and trailer playback.
problem: Building high-performance media catalog applications requires handling massive asynchronous image assets, seamless horizontal carousel interactions, and responsive multi-row categorical filtering without UI stutter.
solution: Developed a modern React single-page application integrating The Movie Database (TMDB) API, utilizing dynamic banner trailers, categorized media rows, and optimized image CDN delivery.
metrics_and_highlights: Integrated 8+ categorical TMDB API endpoints including Originals, Trending Now, Top Rated, and genre-specific rows.
Engineered dynamic hero billboard with randomized featured title metadata and background backdrop transitions.
Integrated embedded video player trailers matching user selection via YouTube/movie-trailer integrations.
Ensured fluid mobile-to-desktop responsive layout using modern CSS flex/grid and Tailwind CSS.

media_catalog_and_display: Dynamic hero banner fetching daily trending releases with responsive backdrop fading
Horizontal scroll rows with hover zoom effects, poster aspect ratios, and smooth lateral scrolling
Categorical filtering across Movies, TV Series, Action, Comedy, Horror, and Documentaries
integration_and_playback: Asynchronous REST data consumption via Axios with centralized TMDB API query configurations
Interactive trailer overlay modals fetching official movie trailers upon poster click
Responsive navigation bar featuring scroll-threshold background opacity transitions
